env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

# A sink reached only through a function value still fails: the audit
# follows the variable to exec.Command and on to os.StartProcess.
cd fv/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/sfv$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/fvdep'' reaches ''os\.StartProcess'''
stderr 'fvdep\.Init\(\)'
stderr 'transitive_exec_allowlist'
cd ../..

# A sink reached only through a method value still fails: the audit
# follows the bound Start call to os.StartProcess.
cd mv/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/smv$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/mvdep'' reaches ''os\.StartProcess'''
stderr 'mvdep\.Init\(\)'
stderr 'transitive_exec_allowlist'
cd ../..

# A sink reached only through a closure stored in a variable still
# fails: the audit follows the stored literal to os.StartProcess.
cd cl/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/scl$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/cldep'' reaches ''os\.StartProcess'''
stderr 'cldep\.Init\(\)'
stderr 'transitive_exec_allowlist'
cd ../..

-- fv/main/go.mod --
module example.com/fvmain

go 1.27

require example.com/fvdep v0.0.0

replace example.com/fvdep => ../dep

-- fv/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"

-- fv/main/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/fvdep"
)

func main() {
	dep.Init()
	fmt.Println("done")
}

-- fv/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/fvdep

go 1.27

-- fv/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import "os/exec"

var execCommand = exec.Command

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	cmd := execCommand("echo", "hi")
	_ = cmd.Run()
}

-- mv/main/go.mod --
module example.com/mvmain

go 1.27

require example.com/mvdep v0.0.0

replace example.com/mvdep => ../dep

-- mv/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"

-- mv/main/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/mvdep"
)

func main() {
	dep.Init()
	fmt.Println("done")
}

-- mv/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/mvdep

go 1.27

-- mv/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import "os/exec"

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	cmd := exec.Command("echo", "hi")
	start := cmd.Start
	_ = start()
}

-- cl/main/go.mod --
module example.com/clmain

go 1.27

require example.com/cldep v0.0.0

replace example.com/cldep => ../dep

-- cl/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"

-- cl/main/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/cldep"
)

func main() {
	dep.Init()
	fmt.Println("done")
}

-- cl/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/cldep

go 1.27

-- cl/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import "os/exec"

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	run := func() {
		_ = exec.Command("echo", "hi").Run()
	}
	run()
}
